data.action: 怀抱厚厚精装书倚在书架旁，透过书架空隙不经意回眸
data.camera: medium shot, standing beside library shelves and peeking between books
data.description: 【艾莉 · 图书馆午后·书架后的凝视】午后静谧的图书馆深处，艾莉怀抱着厚厚的精装参考书穿梭在书架之间。透过书册的缝隙，她悄悄打量着对面正抓耳挠腮做题的你，唇角泛起一抹藏不住的笑意——「这道数学题有那么难吗？真是个让人放不下心的家伙……」
data.lighting: warm dust motes in sunbeams filtering between bookshelves
data.promptProse: Alya pauses beside the library shelves holding thick reference books against her uniform, quietly peeking through a gap at her studying companion across the aisle. A small smile lifts her lips in medium view. Book spines overlap close to her shoulder and the study desk remains farther behind. Afternoon sun reaches between shelves onto her silver hair and the book corners, with dust visible in the warm beam.
data.title: 艾莉莎·米哈伊洛夫娜·九条 · 图书馆午后·书架后的凝视
